values.note: Three Rivers Park District: $22 a site (sites 1-56, two tents or one tent and one RV, six people at most), $24 for site 57 (up to eight people), tax included. $8.25 non-refundable reservation fee and $8.25 per change (changes up to three days before arrival). Bike-in drop-in site $12 a tent.

note: Three Rivers Park District campground in Carver Park Reserve, on a wooded point on Lake Auburn, near an unguarded beach, play area and trails; canoe, kayak, paddleboard, rowboat and bike rentals in season. Generators are allowed only on sites 35-45 (7 a.m.-10 p.m.). --Claude
summary: Three Rivers page and 2026 campground map read: $22 a site ($24 site 57) tax included, $8.25 reservation fee, 120-day window, 55 drive-in sites, no electricity or showers, pit latrines, drinking fountains, free dump; season 2027 opens April 23 (2026 closed October 18). Not waterfront confirmed: a trail and a wooded/marsh band separate the east-row sites (34-45) from Lake Auburn.
flags: Waterfront: keep not waterfront. On the park map an unpaved trail runs between the east-row sites 34-45 and Lake Auburn, and on imagery those pads (about 44.8680,-93.6850) sit ~55-80 m from the open water behind a continuous wooded strip and reed marsh; the south-row sites 13-22 are likewise behind woods and the trail. Site 57 (about 44.8672,-93.6880) sits by the park's west-side fishing pier/swim area (day use). No site has an open apron to the water.

Phone: stored 763-559-6700 is the reservation line; the campground's main number on the page is 763-694-1112. Suggest 763-559-6700 -> 763-694-1112 (reservations stay at 763-559-6700, in booking.note). apply.py does not write phones.
